tools.name: ic_search
tools.description:
Full-text search of Indiana Code sections. Returns section ids, headings and short snippets (one hit per section); fetch the text
        with ic_get_section. `as_of` (YYYY-MM-DD) picks the year's snapshot; `title` limits to one title number such as '31' or '7.1'.

tools.name: ic_resolve_citation
tools.description:
Find Indiana Code citations in free text ('IC 31-16-15-25', 'I.C. § 7.1-1-1-1', 'Ind. Code § 35-42-1-1 (2024)') and return canonical
        section ids, headings, and nearby sections when an id does not exist.

tools.name: ic_get_section
tools.description:
Text of one section, e.g. section_id '31-16-15-25', as of a date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today). Returns the version in force with
        effective dates, amending acts, acts that take effect later (pending_acts), a confidence level and flags. Check `flags` and
        `confidence` before relying on a

tools.name: ic_get_versions
tools.description: All distinct versions of a section across 2017 to 2026 with effective dates, the years each appeared in, and the act clauses that touch it.

tools.name: ic_browse
tools.description: Outline of the Code. With no node_id, list titles; with '31' list articles; with '31-16' chapters; with '31-16-15' sections (latest snapshot).

tools.name: ic_get_act
tools.description: The Code sections an act amended, added or repealed, with effective dates. act_id like 'P.L.98-2026' (loaded for 2017 and 2019 to 2026). Long acts are paged with limit and offset.

tools.name: ic_list_companion
tools.description: List Constitution, Non-code, full Acts, and archive-title PDFs loaded from the IGA downloads page. kind is constitution, noncode, acts, or archive_title.

tools.name: ic_search_companion
tools.description: Full-text search of companion PDFs (Constitution, Non-code statutes, full Acts text, archive titles). Use ic_get_companion for a page.

tools.name: ic_get_companion
tools.description: One page of a companion document (doc_id like 'constitution-2026' or 'acts-2026'). Pages are 1-based.

tools.name: case_search
tools.description: Search Indiana Supreme Court, Court of Appeals, and Tax Court clusters from a CourtListener extract. court is ind, indctapp, or indtc. form is memorandum or opinion when decision forms are indexed (text classification, not official status). disposition is affirmed, reversed, remanded, vacated, dismi

tools.name: case_get
tools.description: One Indiana opinion cluster by CourtListener cluster id. Includes opinion text only when the extract has a body. Includes author when that index is loaded: the slip byline, not the trial judge and not a holding.

tools.name: ic_cases_citing
tools.description: Opinions whose text mentions this Code section (IC / Ind. Code citations). section_id like '35-42-1-1'. This is a text-mention index, not a citator: it does not say the case construed, applied, or followed the statute, and it is not a good-law signal. court is ind, indctapp, or indtc.

tools.name: cases_construing
tools.description: Opinions with a citation-sentence signal for this Code section. relation is construes or applies. section_id like '35-42-1-1'. Status is rule_unreviewed: not a holding, not a citator, not good law. court is ind, indctapp, or indtc.

tools.name: cases_citing_case
tools.description: Opinions whose text cites this case. query is a CourtListener cluster id, a reporter cite such as '848 N.E.2d 341', or an Indiana case number such as '22A-CT-925'. Text-mention index only: not a citator, not treatment, not good law. court is ind, indctapp, or indtc.

tools.name: cases_cited_in
tools.description: Cases this opinion's text cites, resolved against Harvard reporter identifiers and Rule 22 case numbers. query is a cluster id, reporter cite, or case number. Unresolved federal and sister-state reporter mentions are listed separately. Text-mention index only: not a citator, not treatment, not good

tools.name: cases_citing_court
tools.description: Indiana opinions whose text has a (court year) parenthetical. court is an Indigo-style abbreviation such as '7th Cir.', 'N.D. Ind.', 'S.D. Ind.', or 'Ill.'. year is optional (2021). citing_court filters the citing Indiana court (ind, indctapp, indtc). Text-mention index only: not a citator, not trea

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "case_search" is 1116 chars, far longer than this server's median (221). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
